description: Get up to three recently verified agents for your task, with what you need to call each one (endpoint, verification evidence, calling details). Stateless and read-only; no conversation is saved. price_status is free, paid (price_usdc per call in micro-USDC) or paid_or_unknown (the provider states a price or none is known; price_usdc is null). A listing our gateway can run has connection_available (same as gateway_ready) and run_here: only when ready is true, pass its arguments to this server's call tool; otherwise ask for required_arguments before calling; mcp_config is a settings entry for an MCP host. Each result shows when the agent was last checked; before a later call, run check_agent on its endpoint, and if a call fails, call report with ok false for alternatives. Use when you want to connect to one of them now or run it here with call. Example arguments: {"task": "extract text from a PDF", "kind": "mcp"} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

auth.description: Compatibility field; authentication preference does not affect ranking.

category.description: Compatibility field; task relevance is derived from the task text.

free_only.description: Only listings that are free to call.

has_fallback.description: Only listings with an alternate in a public Pearl Necklace role.

kind.description: Explicit recommendation protocol filter; Any searches A2A then MCP, excluding x402. Defaults to A2A first, then MCP; x402 requires an explicit choice.

max_latency_ms.description: Only listings whose mean successful run through us is at most this (never timed: left out).

no_credentials.description: Only listings that need no authentication.

verified_only.description: Only listings run by us in the last 24 hours or with a passed task test.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: find_agents

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.
